consentBody.message: Sites you visit are checked on your device against public threat lists (Phishing.Database, URLhaus) and local look-alike heuristics. No browsing history and no page content ever leaves this device. The optional certificate-age check sends only a bare domain name, never a full URL, to the public crt.sh certificate log, and can be turned off below.
